name: ccpanes-acceptance-pack
description: Read-only acceptance evidence pack for CC-Panes workflows.

scripts.smoke:production: pnpm run build && node dist/src/cli.js validate-request fixtures/request.json --root . && node dist/src/cli.js compose fixtures/request.json --root . --output out/acceptance-pack.json && node dist/src/cli.js validate out/acceptance-pack.json --root . && node dist/src/cli.js explain out/acceptance-pack.json --root . && node dist/src/cli.js validate-request fixtures/native-request.json --root . && node dist/src/cli.js compose fixtures/native-request.json --root . --output out/native-acceptance-pack.json && node dist/src/cli.js validate out/native-acceptance-pack.json --root . && node dist/src/cli.js explain out/native-acceptance-pack.json --root . && pnpm run schema:check
